description.en: Installed DSH plugins of this local profile.
description.zh: 本机 dsh profile 已安装的插件清单。

description.en: Better Sidebar for DSH — file tree, editor, changes, tasks and side chat in one column, separate for every conversation.
description.zh: DSH 增强侧边栏：文件树、编辑器、变更、任务与侧边对话集中于一列，每个会话独立。

description.en: DSH cost attribution and usage dashboard, priced by llm-pricing.
description.zh: DSH 费用统计插件：会话费用行 + 成本归因报告，llm-pricing 动态价格。

description.en: A Codex-style reasoning-effort slider for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: Codex 风格的推理等级滑条：把 DSH 输入框工具行的推理等级档位换成一条可拖动的连续滑条。

description.en: One-click LLM polish for the composer draft via the DSH llm channel, optionally with session context.
description.zh: DSH 草稿润色：发送按钮左侧 ✨ 一键调用 LLM 润色输入框草稿，可选携带会话上下文，走 DSH llm 渠道。

description.en: Session archive management: centralized inventory, batch archive/restore, physical delete with family cascade, and optional auto-archive / auto-cleanup policies.
description.zh: 会话归档管理：集中清点、批量归档/恢复、按会话家族级联物理删除，可选自动归档/自动清理策略。

description.en: Per-provider balance and coding-plan quota detection plus a live token usage ledger with a compact price glance card.
description.zh: 各服务商余额与套餐配额检测，实时 token 用量台账，侧边栏设置行上方价格速览卡片。

description.en: DeepSeek balance whale widget in the bottom-right corner: balance/today/peak-off-peak pricing, customizable bubble click sequences, per-line styles, sounds and per-turn cost, custom characters/animated images/sounds, snap and flip.
description.zh: DSH Web 右下角 DeepSeek 余额小鲸鱼挂件：余额/今日已用/峰谷定价、自定义泡泡点击序列、逐行样式与字体、悬浮快捷编辑、音效与每轮消耗、自定义角色/动图/音效、吸附与翻转。

description.en: Visual plugin market inside DeepSeek Harness — browse, search, and one-click install community plugins.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 可视化插件市场：浏览、搜索、一键安装社区插件。

description.en: AnySearch web search and fetch providers for DeepSeek Harness, with an in-UI API key settings card (fork of @anysearch/anysearch-dsh).
description.zh: AnySearch 网页搜索与抓取提供者，带界面内 API Key 设置卡片（@anysearch/anysearch-dsh 的 fork）。

description.en: Host-policy patches, prompt/rule management, diagnostics, verified updates, and local backup/rollback.
description.zh: 宿主策略补丁、提示词与规则管理、诊断、校验更新和本机备份回滚。

description.en: AnySearch web search and fetch providers plus advanced tools for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: AnySearch 网页搜索与抓取提供者，并提供进阶工具。

description.en: A context-compression plugin — small context windows, fewer tokens, month-long single sessions, for all agents.
description.zh: 上下文压缩插件：小窗口也够用、token 更省、可支撑超长单会话，适配各类 agent。
